blocks.text: KYIV, Ukraine — Ukraine on Thursday accused Russia of failing to change its position on the war, by firing a wave of ballistic missiles just after US envoy Steve Witkoff met President Vladimir Putin to discuss the resumption of peace talks. In a televised interview aired late Thursday, Putin said that any trilateral talks would focus on the security arrangements of a final peace deal and not a “short” truce. Air raid sirens sounded throughout the night and into the day in Kyiv, where two people were killed and more than 30 other people wounded, city authorities said. READ: Zelensky speaks […]...
